data.one_liner: Scan barcodes and QR codes across mobile, web, and Windows platforms.
data.what_it_does: Provides an easy-to-use API and widget for scanning barcodes and QR codes using device cameras on Android, iOS, web, and Windows. It supports both scanning and streaming barcode results.
use_when: You need cross-platform barcode scanning supporting mobile, web, and Windows.
You want a quick pre-built barcode scanning screen or widget rather than building custom camera views.
avoid_when: You need advanced machine learning features combined with barcodes (use google_mlkit_barcode_scanning).
You require robust, native iOS-specific maintenance and active development without relying on older forked libraries.
strengths: Supports web and Windows alongside Android and iOS.
Provides both future-based scanning and stream-based scanning APIs.
Includes customizable app bars and camera configurations.
weaknesses: Flash and switch camera features are limited to mobile devices.
iOS support relies on legacy forked dependencies and testing may be delayed due to hardware availability.
Some inline widget features are Android-only.
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific setup for mobile via flutter_barcode_scanner, and permissions handling for camera access.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: A well-maintained, feature-rich barcode scanner plugin for Flutter supporting mobile platforms with active community support.

alternatives.name: qr_code_scanner_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative QR and barcode scanning option focused primarily on mobile implementations.
